title: Uco Valley Day Wine Tour with Private Driver
sourceTitle: Uco Valley Day Wine Tour with Private Driver

itineraryItems.description:
Located at about an hour drive from Mendoza City and at 1300 meters asl (4265 feets) the Uco Valley region is synonym of exceptional terroir and stunnings views of the Andes Mountains.
Uco Valley has become the paradigm of great Malbecs. 
In a setting of unparalleled beauty with the Andes as a backdrop and in a relaxed atmosphere we will visit different wineries and taste the best wines.
We are experts in the Uco Valley region and will choose for your the best places for visiting, tasting and having amazing argentinian lunch. 
Come with us for your unforgettable day in Uco Valley 
During the tour we visit 3 wineries:
- 2 wineries for visit and tasting of 4/5 wines
- A 3rd winery for a delicious courses lunch paired with wines.
IMPORTANT! : for tasting and lunch during the day consider around usd 150 per person (in the "All inclusive" option that is included).
WE LIST 6 WINERIES but keep in mind that during a day we visit 3 of them.

Option: FINCA ADELMA Winery
Finca Adelma is a small, family-run winery where you can enjoy a warm, personalized experience, tasting exquisite wines paired with cheeses and delicious empanadas. It’s a perfect complement to a visit to a larger winery—like our favorite among the big names, Bodega Salentein—and a great way to see how small and large players coexist in the majestic Uco Valley. We love Finca Adelma!

Domaine Bousquet: Organic. Biodynamics. Domaine Bousquet is a renowned winery known for its high-altitude vineyards and commitment to organic and sustainable winemaking practices. The winery has an breathtaking view of the Andes. 
Tasting is around USD 25

Salentein is known as the Cathedral of the Vallley. 
And we consider it the perfect match of majestic arquitecture, combined with a world class art gallery, breathtaking landscape, one of its kind cellar and very good wines. 
It is a "Must" of the Valley!
We usually include SALENTEIN; but is also possible to customize your day, including some other winery.
Visit and tasting at Salentein is about USD 30 per person

Set in the heart of the Andes Mountains, Bodega Andeluna delivers one of Mendoza’s most captivating wine experiences. Elegant architecture, pristine vineyards, and endless mountain views create a stunning backdrop, while warm, attentive service elevates every moment. Guests consistently highlight not only the quality of the wines, but the seamless blend of scenery, gastronomy, and personalized hospitality—designed to be savored and remembered.
Four courses lunch paired with wines is around USD 85

title: Vineyards Tour in Mendoza: Wine & Olive Oil Tasting Experience
sourceTitle: Vineyards Tour in Mendoza: Wine & Olive Oil Tasting Experience

itineraryItems.description: At 2:30 PM we will be picked up from our selected hotels to head towards the Luján de Cuyo and Maipú area, where the wineries we will visit are located.

Through this circuit we will get in touch with the culture of work in the hands of immigrants who, using irrigation techniques inherited from the aborigines, such as canals and ditches, managed to transform the desert soil into a productive oasis.

In this panorama, prestigious wineries proliferated, which have positioned Argentina as a privileged producer at the international level thanks to the quality of its products.

We will visit two wineries where we can learn more about the traditional methods and also about the incorporation of the latest technology. Accompanied by expert winery guides and oenologists, they will show us the vinification methods and the wine making, bottling and labeling processes. After the visit, we will be invited to taste these delicious wines.

We will also make a visit to an olive establishment, where we will observe the process of making olive oil, also of excellent quality, and then we will be offered a tasting.
At 20:00 we will be arriving to Mendoza where you will be taken again to your hotel.

itineraryItems.description: We will start the tour looking for passengers in the central accommodations
The first place to visit will be a traditional olive tree located in Maipu. There you will know about the production process and taste different products

At the end of the visit in the olive grove we will go to visit 3 wineries in the area of Maipu known as "the cradle of wine and olive". These 3 small regional wineries (Corbel, Esencia, Viña El Cerno) and of little production will receive us to show us their ways of elaboration. We will taste in each place at least 3 wines! In the last cellar we will make a 4-step lunch paired with wines. Vegetarian option. Option for coeliacs and vegans please give 48 hours notice.
At the end of lunch we will return to the city. Depending on traffic, the travel time from the warehouse to dropping passengers off at their accommodation is 1 hour.

title: Private Mendoza WineTour: 3 Premium Wineries Michelin-Guide Lunch
sourceTitle: Private Mendoza WineTour: 3 Premium Wineries Michelin-Guide Lunch

itineraryItems.description:
Visit Chandon in Agrelo, one of Mendoza’s most renowned wine regions, and discover the art of sparkling wine surrounded by vineyards and the Andes. During the guided visit, learn about Chandon’s French heritage, its winemaking tradition in Argentina, and the distinctive character of the Mendoza terroir.

The experience concludes with a tasting of selected Chandon wines, allowing you to discover the winery’s signature style in an elegant and welcoming atmosphere.

Visit Budeguer Winery in Agrelo, one of Mendoza’s renowned wine-growing regions, and discover a family-owned winery surrounded by vineyards and spectacular views of the Andes. During the guided visit, learn about the winery’s winemaking philosophy, its connection to the terroir, and the care that goes into producing its wines.

The experience concludes with a tasting of selected Budeguer wines, offering the opportunity to discover the character and diversity of Mendoza’s terroir in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere.

Enjoy the highlight of your Mendoza wine experience at Lagarde Winery, one of the region’s historic wineries, where tradition, wine, and gastronomy come together.

At Fogón, Lagarde’s acclaimed restaurant recognized by the MICHELIN Guide, enjoy an elegant four-course lunch inspired by the flavors and seasonal ingredients of Mendoza. Each course is thoughtfully paired with selected Lagarde wines, creating a harmonious journey through the region’s cuisine and winemaking tradition.

Surrounded by vineyards and the beautiful landscape of Luján de Cuyo, this is more than a lunch—it is a chance to slow down, savor exceptional food and wine, and experience Mendoza at its most refined and authentic.

travelerPickup.additionalInfo:
Lujan de Cuyo area of Mendoza, with the stunning view of the Andes mountain range, is an area known for its fantastic malbec production. 
This private day trip with a knowledgeable and experience driver guide is a convenient and stress-free option.
During the day we visit three wineries, enjoying wine tastings in two of them and a delicious gourmet lunch in a third winery, with special pairings to complement the food. Explore the beautiful Lujan de Cuyo, land of Malbec and relax in comfortable transportation in a private air-conditioned vehicle (with all the legal authorization for doing this tours).

title: Chocolates and Olive Winery Tour in Mendoza
sourceTitle: Chocolates and Olive Winery Tour in Mendoza

itineraryItems.description: The guide will meet you in the winery and take you through the vineyards explaining the winemaking process, from the grapes to the bottle. You will enjoy a guided tasting of their best varietal wines, knowing the Mendoza terroir and the unique characteristics of each strain.

You will visit a boutique olive grove where you will know the process of producing artisan olive oil. You will tour the olive groves, see the cold extraction process and enjoy a tasting of premium oils and regional products.

You will tour one of the most traditional wineries in Maipu, with a history of more than 100 years. Your guide will take you through the historic facilities, the aging caves and finish with a more representative wine tasting

You will visit Vistandes, a boutique winery with a privileged view of the Andes mountain range. You will know its artisanal process and enjoy a tasting of its high-end wines with the Andean landscape as background

We close the tour with a visit to Chocolezza, where you will discover the perfect pairing between artisanal Mendoza chocolate and the wines of the region. A unique experience for the palate that combines two of Mendoza’s best products.

title: All Day, Small Group, Luxury Wine Tour with Gourmet Lunch
sourceTitle: All Day, Small Group, Luxury Wine Tour with Gourmet Lunch

itinerary.unstructuredDescription: Pick up is at 8.45am at your hotel in the Mendoza City area.  We visit three wineries throughout the day and have premum tastings including Malbec at each winery.  At the first winery we also do a tour of the facility to see what makes Argentine so unique. Each winery we visit is very different and we include small boutique operations and larger, big name wineries. We then have a 5-course gourmet lunch with 5 wines at a winery with beautiful mountan views. We return to your Mendoza City hotel at 5.30pm.  The group size is maximum eight people and the price includes tastings and lunch with wine. A guide accompanies you all day and the tour is conducted in an air-conditioned Mercedes mini-bus.  Mineral water is provided in the transport vehicle.
